summary: Held curl at its current version on node1 via apt-mark hold, verified it survives both a simulated and a real apt-get upgrade, and completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol (boot_id changed, curl still held and unchanged post-reboot).
actions_performed: Inspected OS/package manager and captured baseline curl version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 (cmd-1769e523647645a3)
Ran `sudo apt-mark hold curl` and confirmed via apt-mark showhold (cmd-a21ca74303e34a60)
Ran apt-get update and a simulated (-s) upgrade; curl appeared only in the 'kept back' list, no Inst line for curl (cmd-5e0b72e183d14eed, cmd-849079422dc94ef8)
Ran a real `apt-get upgrade -y` across the system (cmd-a58fa59653af4b92)
Verified curl package status 'hi' (hold+installed) and version unchanged after the real upgrade (cmd-d24cff7c391b4254)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and curl hold state (cmd-8da083ae79614a93)
Issued `sudo shutdown -r now` on node1; ack returned before disconnect (cmd-62b1705f42434e80)
Polled node1 until exec was available again; first poll timed out, second succeeded (cmd-4820c1fe71e64633, cmd-dfc9c62217674578)
Verified changed boot_id and confirmed curl remained held at the same version post-restart (cmd-4d9fbcd0db9f4e86)

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 on node1
evidence.summary: Baseline curl version captured, then apt-mark hold curl applied and confirmed in showhold list

evidence.requirement: Hold prevents curl from being upgraded during a system update
evidence.summary: Simulated upgrade showed curl kept back (no Inst curl line); a real full apt-get upgrade was run; post-upgrade dpkg -l shows curl status 'hi' (hold+installed) still at 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (96c08b66...) and curl hold state, issued shutdown -r now (ack returned before disconnect), polled until exec available again, then confirmed new boot_id (30c275ad...) and that curl remained held at the unchanged version post-restart
